searchText: How can I get some goerli eth? is there any place where I can find a fresh list of enodes of EL clients on the mainnet shadow fork? did you already try the list here? https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/mainnet-shadow-fork-1 looks like Besu and Nethermind have halted on the same block, 14,564,207. We are still investigating. ^thats merge block afaik indeed it is i'm guessing you restarted besu and nethermind at the same time Nope, I just restarted teku-besu today to enable ethstats. So it should have synced way past merge block. Lighthouse-besu has been untouched since friday/sat i think (pre merge) Nethermind being stuck at the merge block is totally unrelated to restarts and the team is looking into it afaik thank you for doing that btw. not touching light-besu means some very helpful clues were preserved in logs
